# Objects

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------+
| Object/Class                      | Description                                                                                                                                               | Stored data                                                                | Methods              |
+===================================+===========================================================================================================================================================+============================================================================+======================+
| landscape                         | Describes a landscape (a set of sites with spatial locations and associated features and boundaries that might influence movement)                        | n: total number of stored sites                                            | print.landscape      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | sites: one of:                                                             | summary.landscape    |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | matrix (2 columns, 1 for x and 1 for y of sites)                           | plot.landscape       |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | sfc (POINT or POLYGON types only)                                          | downscale.landscape  |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | adjacency graph (saying which sites neighbour which)                       | em_dist.landscape    |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | features (optional): one of:                                               |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | tibble (with n rows and columns for each property)                         |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | list of rasters (maybe?)                                                   |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | boundaries (optional; features that are impassible to movement): sf object |                      |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------+
| movemodel                         | An object that estimates the rates of movement between two different locations given a set of inputs                                                      | Not sure of the best way of storing this                                   |                      |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------+
| generator                         | Describes pairwise movement rates                                                                                                                         | one of:                                                                    | print.generator      |

|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |

|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | function                                                                   |                      |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------+
| paths                             | Describes steps taken on a landscape image                                                                                                                | tibble with columns:                                                       | print.paths          |

|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | time                                                                       | summary.paths        |

|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            | summary.patches      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            |                      |
|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                            | plot.patches         |

| eigenmove                         | The low-rank approximation of a Markov-Chain random walk model                                                                                            | landscape (optional)                                                       | em_simpath.eigenmove |

|                                   |                                                                                                                                                           | continuous (TRUE or FALSE)                                                 | em_cluster.eigenmove |
